summary: The enterprise AI model API landscape is dominated by the three hyperscalers—AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Azure (now Foundry/Azure OpenAI), and Google Vertex AI—which let corporations access foundation models like GPT, Claude, Llama, and Gemini via secure managed APIs without data leaving their cloud tenant. There is no universally 'best' platform: Bedrock leads on model breadth and EU options, Azure on deep OpenAI/GPT integration, and Vertex on Google's Gemini and MLOps tooling, while data-centric challengers like Snowflake Cortex AI (with Claude) and IBM watsonx win when governed enterprise data is the priority. Selection typically follows an organization's existing cloud contracts, data-residency needs, and compliance posture rather than raw model quality alone.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and security: prompts, responses, and fine-tuning data stay within the company's own cloud tenant/VPC and chosen region, never leaving to a third-party vendor's infrastructure.
Compliance and certifications: aggregators provide SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and FedRAMP coverage out of the box, which individual model-vendor APIs often lack at enterprise scale.
Consolidated billing and existing cloud contracts: usage rolls into existing AWS/Azure/GCP enterprise agreements and committed spend, simplifying procurement and leveraging discounts.
Model choice and avoiding lock-in: a single API surface exposes many models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, etc.), letting teams switch or multi-source without re-architecting.
Enterprise governance: unified audit logging, IAM/RBAC, private networking, guardrails, and monitoring integrate with existing security and observability tooling.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service / Microsoft Foundry
available_models: various open models via Foundry Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens, with Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; billed through Azure enterprise agreements.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises standardized on Microsoft/Azure that want first-class access to OpenAI GPT models with the strongest compliance and ecosystem integration.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing plus Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity; batch pricing discounts; billed via AWS accounts.
platforms.best_for: AWS-centric enterprises wanting the widest choice of models (especially Anthropic Claude) and strong EU/data-residency options.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
available_models: various open models via Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token/character with Provisioned Throughput; committed use discounts; billed through Google Cloud.
key_features: Grounding with Google Search / RAG Engine
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud customers wanting Gemini plus a managed model garden with enterprise-grade MLOps and data-grounding.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based, billed in Snowflake credits tied to compute usage within the Snowflake account.
key_features: Models run next to governed data (no data movement)
platforms.best_for: Data-centric enterprises that want to bring AI and agents directly to governed data in their Snowflake warehouse with minimal data movement.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Subscription plus consumption-based (Resource Units/tokens); available on IBM Cloud, on-prem, and hybrid.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises (finance, government, healthcare) needing on-prem/hybrid deployment, AI governance, and IP indemnification.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-character/token plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; billed via OCI.
key_features: Tight integration with Oracle Fusion/Database/Autonomous DB
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric enterprises wanting generative AI embedded in Oracle applications and databases with sovereign/dedicated capacity.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Usage-based (per neuron/request) with generous free tier; serverless edge pricing, billed via Cloudflare.
key_features: Serverless inference at global edge (low latency)
AI Gateway for caching, rate-limiting, logging across providers
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises wanting low-latency, globally distributed serverless inference and a provider-agnostic AI gateway rather than a single heavyweight model host.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBUs plus token/compute pricing; runs within customer cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) account.
platforms.best_for: Lakehouse-centric enterprises wanting to build, fine-tune, and serve models directly on governed data with strong MLOps.
